name: @psyb0t/decidealot
summary: Connect an OpenClaw agent to local Laya and Von typed decisions over MCP.
description: A thin stdio to HTTP bridge for a self-hosted Decidealot MCP endpoint. It forwards typed choice, score, and true or false decision calls to a Decidealot container that the user already runs.

DECIDEALOT_URL.description: Base URL of the user's running Decidealot instance. The bridge appends /mcp.

DECIDEALOT_API_KEY.description: Bearer token when the Decidealot container has DECIDEALOT_API_KEY configured.

url.description: Base URL of the user's running Decidealot instance. The bridge appends /mcp.

apiKey.description: Bearer token when the Decidealot container has DECIDEALOT_API_KEY configured.
